description: This Java source file defines a BroadcastReceiver class 'GetRestrictionsReceiver' that manages app restrictions by creating, populating, and retaining restriction entries, responding asynchronously when restrictions are requested, and integrating with the Android Restrictions API.

classes.name: GetRestrictionsReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver subclass that manages app restriction entries, initializes default restrictions, and updates restrictions based on existing settings and user preferences.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the broadcast, initiates asynchronous creation of restrictions.

methods.name: populateBooleanEntry
methods.description: Sets up a boolean type restriction entry.

methods.name: populateChoiceEntry
methods.description: Initializes a single-choice restriction entry with options.

methods.name: initRestrictions
methods.description: Creates default restriction entries for boolean, choice, and multi-select types.

methods.name: createRestrictions
methods.description: Constructs and returns restriction entries, retaining existing settings, and optionally sets custom restriction activity.
